180. (1) For the purposes of this Part, the Institute Board
may appoint a Team of Instructors and an Operations Team
from  universities  and  public  institutions  that  produce
economic,  international  finance  and  international  trade
knowledge  and  from  privately  funded  independent  Think
Tanks on secondment basis.
(2) Any person appointed to the Team of Instructors and
the Operations Team, as the case may be, shall be subject to
the provisions of this Part.
(3)  The  members  of  the  Team  of  Instructors  and  the
Operations Team shall be paid remuneration in such manner
and at such rates as may be determined by the Minister with
the  concurrence  of  the  Minister  assigned  the  subject  of
Finance.
